body.p: Lǃałōʼlsla had a fishing camp near the place G̣auiʼs. There were two in the canoe, / he and his wife, fishing with halibut line. The canoe was on the water at Āʼx·adī. Then he saw / [people] paddling coming over from their camp. Behold! they had finished killing their camp fellows. / Now the warriors spoke, "Let us play with those little ones paddling there." Then the warriors went out to sea after them. They discovered that / these were warriors. Now Lǃałōʼlsla got his amunition ready. They paddled around / Āʼx·adī. When the Halda were on the other side of the island, / after he had paddled once round, he paddled out seaward. Then he arrived seaward on / the other side of Āʼx·adī. They went very far out seaward. Then the warriors came in sight. His wife paddled seaward. Then Lǃałōʼlsla made himself ready. / He blackened his face. The warriors started after him. He shouted, / "Go on," said he. "We will play. It is I to whom you come. I Lǃałōʼlsla," said he. / Now the warriors stopped on the water. They were talking among themselves. / Then they began to shoot. Now he knew that the chief was sitting in the stern of the canoe while the warriors were shouting. Now just that one was shot by Lǃałōʼlsla when his head came in sight. / It was not long before his wife was hit by a ricochetting bullet. / She lay with her chest around the paddle when she was struck in the back. She lay with her chest on the paddle. / Her head did not fall down forward in in the canoe. Now he was shouted at by the Haida, / but the brave Lǃałōʼlsla did not pay any attention. Then one man sitting in the stern raised his head. He shot and he was struck in the forehead by the bullet. / The canoe listed at once. Thus the chief of the canoe / Kǃñᵋyiʼns by name, was hit. They began to sing his mourning song. Then they left him. / They had not been long in the canoe before the wife of Lǃałōʼlsla moved. / When he saw it he jumped towards her and put his wife upright in the canoe. She felt of herself to see if she was really hit. Now she became strong.
